num_customers: <int> Total number of customers to be served.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand each vehicle can carry under any realized demand scenario.

uncertainty_set.Gamma: <int> Maximum number of customers whose demands may simultaneously deviate from their nominal values.

depot.id: <int> Identifier for the depot node in the distance matrix.

customers.id: <int> Unique identifier for the customer, used as a node index in the distance matrix.
customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.nominal_demand: <int> Expected demand quantity for the customer under normal conditions.
customers.demand_deviation: <int> Maximum amount by which the customer's actual demand can exceed its nominal demand.

distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Transportation cost between each pair of locations, where row/column 0 is the depot and rows/columns 1 through num_customers are customers.
